notes.title: Announcing Get Down and Buggie at the Wholesome Games Celebration!
notes.content:
It was quite a rush to get here but we are finally part of the Celebration!
And Celebration is maybe the most appropriate word to describe our party themed, bug filled management game. We are grateful to have a spot on the Wholesome games show next to all the other indie devs.

If you like the game consider wishlisting and if you extra like the game you can follow us on Twitter (https://twitter.com/AzmioDV). But only after you’ve had time to enjoy some of our concept art and additional buggies!



PS: Row 3, Column 4 is my favorite.
